item.research_question: Can Ti-rich Ti-Zr-Nb-Ta medium-entropy alloys with β+α″+α′ structure be developed for biomedical applications?
item.processing_route: Vacuum arc-melting and casting, followed by solution treatment at 900 °C for 20 min
item.test_conditions: Three-point bending test, potentiodynamic polarization test in phosphate-buffered saline at 37 °C
key_findings: Ti65-Zr29-Nb3-Ta3 exhibited ultra-high bending strength (1102 MPa) and low elastic modulus (49 GPa)
Ti65-Zr29-Nb3-Ta3 had excellent corrosion resistance with a pitting potential higher than 1.8 V
The surface passivation layer of Ti65-Zr29-Nb3-Ta3 mainly comprised TiO2, ZrO2, Nb2O5, and Ta2O5
item.mechanism: The lattice distortion effects and composition segregation of the MEAs influenced the phase structure and properties
item.limitations: The conventional VEC formula used for predicting phases was not entirely applicable to the Ti-Zr-Nb-Ta MEAs
quotes: The conventional VEC formula used for predicting phases was not entirely applicable to the Ti-Zr-Nb-Ta MEAs
Ti65-Zr29-Nb3-Ta3 had excellent mechanical strength, a low elastic modulus, excellent elastic/plastic deformation ability, and excellent corrosion resistance

records.text: Paper card. Question: Can Ti-rich Ti-Zr-Nb-Ta medium-entropy alloys with β+α″+α′ structure be developed for biomedical applications?. System: Ti-Zr-Nb-Ta medium-entropy alloys. Processing: Vacuum arc-melting and casting, followed by solution treatment at 900 °C for 20 min. Test conditions: Three-point bending test, potentiodynamic polarization test in phosphate-buffered saline at 37 °C. Findings: Ti65-Zr29-Nb3-Ta3 exhibited ultra-high bending strength (1102 MPa) and low elastic modulus (49 GPa); Ti65-Zr29-Nb3-Ta3 had excellent corrosion resistance with a pitting potential higher than 1.8 V; The surface passivation layer of Ti65-Zr29-Nb3-Ta3 mainly comprised TiO2, ZrO2, Nb2O5, and Ta2O5. Mechanism: The lattice distortion effects and composition segregation of the MEAs influenced the phase structure and properties. Limitations: The conventional VEC formula used for predicting phases was not entirely applicable to the Ti-Zr-Nb-Ta MEAs. Quote: "The conventional VEC formula used for predicting phases was not entirely applicable to the Ti-Zr-Nb-Ta MEAs"
